proxy.how: Command hooks: PreToolUse shows text before each tool call (from the transcript, in a detached process). After a tool-free reply, PostInvocation shows the reply and holds the execution open for what you type on the resident, continuing with force_continue + userMessage (and PreInvocation picks up anything mid-turn or once idle). Temporary until Antigravity CLI adds a native turn-start / idle wake-up API.

docs.summary: Install pixling-proxy in the Antigravity CLI: replies show on the resident, and PostInvocation holds the turn open so what you write continues the conversation.
